---
title: "Relations"
---

A relation records which ordered pairs from two sets are related.

::: {#def-relation name="Relation" .definition}
Let $X$ and $Y$ be sets. A *relation* over $X \times Y$ is a subset $R \subseteq X \times Y$.

If $Y=X$, the relation is called *homogeneous*. When $(x,y)\in R$, we say that $x$ is related to $y$ and write $xRy$.
:::

The definition in @def-relation treats a relation as a set of ordered pairs. Equivalently, its indicator is a proposition-valued function of two arguments.
